Subject: Procurement intake & vendor setup - Lyra Biosciences

Hi Jordan,

Great speaking with you earlier - thanks for the time and for walking through Lyra's immediate use cases for model-powered R&D search. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Recap: Pilot scope is 3 months, internal R&D search + embedding indexing, estimated 50k monthly queries.
- Commercial path: sounds like procurement will prefer a PO for production, but you may use a company card for the initial pilot. Can you confirm which you expect to use for the pilot order?
- Paperwork: to get started with vendor setup your procurement team will need our vendor packet + W-9 and Redwood banking details template (for ACH/wire). I attached our packet and W-9 to this email.
- Marketplace: we also support AWS Marketplace and can provide a marketplace invoice path if that simplifies purchasing - let me know if procurement wants that option.

Next steps for your team:
1) Send the completed vendor intake form and any required banking info or tell me if you prefer we upload to your vendor portal.
2) Confirm PO vs card for the pilot and whether Net30 is acceptable to you.
3) If procurement needs a specific vendor portal contact, share the onboarding link and we can complete the profile.

I CC'd Dylan Brooks from our onboarding team to help with vendor portal and vendor packet questions.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (PDF, 220KB); Redwood_W-9.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement:

- We generally require a completed vendor packet, a W-9 and banking details for ACH.
- For pilots under $10k we can usually pay by company card; for anything expected to be invoiced we need a PO and our standard Net30 terms. The pilot estimate you gave is likely under the card threshold but procurement will confirm.
- We have a vendor portal (Coupa) and prefer vendors to pre-register there. I'll attach our intake template so your finance team can fill it out.

Could you confirm Redwood's banking information format (routing/account vs SWIFT) and whether you can accept ACH? Also, do you have a preferred contact for PO review/contract questions?

I'll aim to get the intake form back to you by EOD tomorrow and will loop in procurement if they need to speak with your finance team.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Procurement Manager, Lyra Biosciences
jordan.ellis@lyra-bio.com
(650) 555-0199

- Banking: we can provide ACH (routing/account), domestic wire (routing/account), and SWIFT for international transfers. Our finance team prefers ACH for US customers; bank details template attached.
- Payment terms: We can accept PO with Net30 for committed contracts. For pilot invoices under $10k we can accept card.
- PO review/legal: For contract or PO questions, our legal contact is Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwood.ai) - copying Dylan to coordinate any handoffs to legal or finance.
- Marketplace: If you prefer AWS Marketplace, let me know and I can share the marketplace order path and seller ID.

Links and docs:
